about_the_game:
Who is the Outsider?

Outsider is a science fiction narrative game with meaningful choices. You'll join my childhood friend Nando in his online encounters with a woman claiming to be an extraterrestrial. This game is a faithful recreation of their conversations based on the detailed records he left me before disappearing over a decade ago.

Outsider is a choice-rich game where you will play as Nando's "inner voice", helping him navigate the experience of meeting someone claiming to be from an advanced civilization.

The game's main play area is a fully-featured simulated chat interface. Your first job will be to help Nando figure out whether "Mara" is who she claims to be. How could an extraterrestrial prove their origin through a chat interface?

Outsider doesn't interrupt conversations with long and indistinguishable options. All choices are labeled with emojis that indicate the answer's tone and likely impact. Consequences flow naturally and won't unexpectedly lock you out of important content.

Some choices enable you to skip parts of the story and make progress while not missing anything important. You will use them to pace the game and focus on topics that interest you without affecting the game's endings. A plethora of reading options, such as multiple fonts (including a special Dyslexia-friendly font), adjustable text speed and fast-forward will help you explore all branches without getting bogged down by what you've already read.

Nando has unexplained dreams throughout Outsider. Are they telling him anything? Crack an optional and challenging metapuzzle and help him peel hidden layers from the narrative. Solving the puzzle is a reward in itself, but you can save it for later if you want.

Game Features

  • A dynamic hand-crafted narrative where decisions matter: In Outsider, individual choices always affect the story, but a single "wrong" choice will never lock you out of an ending.

  • Novel-length story and dozens of choices: countless paths and multiple endings.

  • No "bad" or "gotcha" endings: there will always be something to learn from the experience - no matter what you decide.

  • Locations around the world and beyond: travel to the Americas, Europe, Asia and more.

  • Detailed depiction of Alien science and technology: explore the answers to some of our most important and oldest questions. Outsider's "hard sci-fi" technology is equally credible and extraordinary.

  • A tough but optional overarching puzzle: a mystery that will keep puzzle lovers on their toes while allowing everybody to reach the game's many endings.

  • Comprehensive reader features include fast forward, inline history scrolling, hands-free advance, keyboard-only operation and much more.

  • Accessibility options allow you to heavily customize your experience with different fonts, including a Dyslexia-friendly one, text speeds and font sizes.

content_descriptors.notes:
This game does not contain explicit violence or sexual content. However, it includes verbal sexual innuendo and references to nonviolent criminal acts.

Additionally, the game explores existential themes, including extraterrestrial life, religion and life after death. While these topics are presented with humor, some players may find them sensitive.
